video.title: Reading List That Actually Works
video.script: You're sitting on thousands of saved links. You'll read maybe fifty. Stack fixes that. Paste any link, get back a short summary, the passages that matter, and a tag. When you actually need it later, you can find it again without scrolling forever. No signup, no ads, just runs right in your browser. Try it now.
